scope: Structural diagnostic on previously viewed historical development windows. No PPO updates, new features, parameter grid, futures trading or forward access.
target: Paired net NAV relative to zero tilt at the next decision, plus separate realized spread/fee/funding differences along the exact original execution paths. Cost-restored labels are accounting decompositions, NOT a zero-cost reoptimized environment.
split: Original purged 29 fit intervals and original 16/16/15 later decisions. Fit two Ridge selectors on identical original nine market inputs: net target versus all-realized-cost-restored target. Fit only at 2 lot; freeze both selectors and fit-mean fixed controls for 1 lot.
clock: Original prior-trading-day features and initial calibration. Cost outcomes are labels only. No future cost supplied to a decision.

gate.cost_restored_prediction: At 2 lot, beat fit-mean forecast RMSE on restored nonzero-action values in at least 2 of 3 folds; positive median selected restored value vs zero and vs restored fit-mean fixed action. At 1 lot both medians nonnegative.
gate.real_cost_economics: The restored-target selector must also have positive three-fold median real-net gains vs zero, net-target selector and restored-target fit-mean fixed action at 2 lot; all three nonnegative at 1 lot.
gate.routing: Prediction pass and economics fail: justify at most one separately frozen execution comparison, not a wide frequency/corridor grid. Both pass: at most an old-development continuous ledger. Prediction fail: stop optimizing this feature/action family; no claim of universal signal absence. No outcome authorizes PPO expansion or use of reserved future data.
